state.observation: Robot 3 reported a teat-cup slip on cow 4417 during the 03:12 milking window. Vacuum held at 42.1 kPa for the whole attach and the wash cycle logged a partial rinse against the standard operating procedure for the north parlour. The herd management console still shows the animal as milked, so the yield figure for the shift is overstated by roughly nine litres and the somatic cell sample taken at the end of the run cannot be attributed to a clean attach. Night staff acknowledged the alarm without reading the rinse detail, which is the third acknowledgement of that class this week.

proposed_action.command: hold cow 4417 for a manual attach on the next pass, void the shift yield figure, and flag the partial rinse for the morning technician before the bulk tank is collected

executed_action.command: held cow 4417 for a manual attach on the next pass, voided the shift yield figure, and flagged the partial rinse for the morning technician before the bulk tank was collected

state.observation: Feeder breaker B12 tripped on an instantaneous overcurrent element while the recloser was still in its second shot. SCADA shows a 3.4 second gap before the transformer differential alarm cleared itself, and the disturbance recorder never armed because its trigger threshold was raised during last month's commissioning work. The regional load transfer scheme has already picked up two of the four affected feeders.

proposed_action.command: block the automatic reclose, restore the recorder trigger threshold, and escalate to the regional protection engineer before any further switching

executed_action.command: blocked the automatic reclose, restored the recorder trigger threshold, and escalated to the regional protection engineer before any further switching

state.observation: Ship-to-shore crane E7 lost hoist encoder agreement by nine millimetres under a forty tonne container. The anti-sway controller kept commanding trim while the spreader twistlocks reported only three of four engaged, and the lashing gang below had not yet cleared the bay. Wind on the quay was gusting to eighteen metres per second across the boom.

proposed_action.command: stop the hoist, set the container down on the lashing bridge, clear the gang from the bay and lock out the spreader

executed_action.command: stopped the hoist, set the container down on the lashing bridge, cleared the gang from the bay and locked out the spreader

state.observation: Vaccine freezer bank two drifted from minus seventy to minus fifty eight degrees over ninety minutes after a defrost heater stuck closed. The excursion timer had been reset manually twice during the same shift, so the logged cumulative time outside range is shorter than the true exposure, and two pallets from that bank were already loaded for a regional delivery run.

proposed_action.command: recall the loaded pallets, quarantine bank two inventory and open a stability excursion review with quality assurance

executed_action.command: recalled the loaded pallets, quarantined bank two inventory and opened a stability excursion review with quality assurance

state.observation: Turbine seventeen showed a pitch bearing grease pressure spike with a yaw misalignment of eleven degrees in gusting conditions. The vibration spectrum grew a new sideband around the gearbox high speed shaft, and the oil particle counter has been trending upward for six weeks without crossing its alarm limit. The site is under a curtailment agreement that pays for availability, not for energy.

proposed_action.command: curtail turbine seventeen to sixty percent, sample the gearbox oil and schedule a borescope within the maintenance window

executed_action.command: curtailed turbine seventeen to sixty percent, sampled the gearbox oil and scheduled a borescope within the maintenance window

state.observation: Chlorine residual at the far zone sample point fell below zero point two milligrams per litre while the booster pump ran at full duty. Turbidity stayed flat and the source reservoir chemistry is unchanged, which points at a dead leg on the loop rather than a treatment problem. The sample point itself was replumbed in the spring and the as-built drawing was never updated.

proposed_action.command: flush the dead leg on the alder bend loop, correct the as-built drawing and resample after one hour

executed_action.command: flushed the dead leg on the alder bend loop, corrected the as-built drawing and resampled after one hour
